g.aria-label: The Adjoint Scan: Forward Prefix Scan + Reverse Gradient Scan
Forward Pass (t = 1 → T): h_t = a_t ⊙ h_{t-1} + b_t
Evaluated in O(log₂ T) parallel doubling rounds; discards intermediate rounds!
Saves ONLY final state trajectory h_{1:T} and decay factors a_{1:T} (2 tensors total)
Backward Pass (t = T → 1): g_t = ∂L/∂h_t + a_{t+1} ⊙ g_{t+1}
Time-reversed linear recurrence! Evaluated in O(log₂ T) via flip(a) → parallel_scan → flip
Parameter gradients recovered elementwise: ∂L/∂b_t = g_t, ∂L/∂a_t = g_t ⊙ h_{t-1}
Production Mamba fuses discretization + scan into SRAM so (B, T, H, N) never touches HBM
